short: Unofficial Telegram clients on one Rust core
is: The rusty-telly Cargo workspace: Unofficial Mini Telegram (Limited, browser) and Unofficial Rusty Telegram (Full, desktop) over one ports-and-adapters core, GPL-3.0-or-later.
conventions: Dependencies point inward: domain ← application ← adapters and apps; scripts/boundaries.sh fails the gate otherwise.
Every member carries `[lints] workspace = true`, so `unsafe_code` is forbidden in every crate we write; dependencies may use unsafe.
Dependencies are exact-pinned in `[workspace.dependencies]` and Cargo.lock is committed; a bump is its own change.
`just gate` runs everything CI runs: fmt, clippy (native and wasm32), test, cargo-deny, boundaries.
